Transcript 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Contents 

 
 
 
 
 
 Introduction 
 
 
 
 
 
 Introduction 
 Jesse 
Today, we will be diving into energy giant Exxon Mobil. The origins of Exxon date back to John D. Rockefeller and Standard Oil. Exxon was spun out in 1911 as the Standard Oil of New Jersey. And in 1998, Exxon merged with Mobil, which was the original Standard Oil of New York. To break down the rich history of Exxon, I am joined by Arjun Murti, a long time energy analyst and investor. During our conversation, we dive deep into the super major business and how that drove Exxon century long success. We addressed the past decade of under performance and examine the key drivers of Exxon Mobil moving forward. Arjun gives helpful overviews on how the energy market has changed across fossil fuels and renewables throughout our conversation. I hope you enjoy this business breakdown of Exxon Mobil. All right. Arjun Murti, welcome to Business Breakdowns.

 Arjun 
Thank you, Jesse, it's a real pleasure to be here.
